chartDesign.layouts.addElement.axes.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Axes: shows or hides the labels of the horizontal and vertical axis (the horizontal axis of a bar chart is its value axis); Excel's More Axis Options and the secondary axes are not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartDesign.layouts.addElement.data-tabl.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Data Table: the series values in a table under a column, line or area chart, with or without legend keys. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartDesign.layouts.addElement.error-bar.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Error Bars: Standard Error, Percentage (5%) and Standard Deviation (one) on every series of a column, bar, line, area, scatter or bubble chart, both directions with end caps; Excel's More Error Bars Options is not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartDesign.layouts.addElement.lines.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Lines: Drop Lines (line and area charts), High-Low Lines (line charts) and Series Lines (stacked column and bar charts); each is offered for the charts Excel offers it for. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartDesign.layouts.addElement.up-down-b.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Up/Down Bars: bars between the first and the last series of a line chart (white when the last is higher, dark when lower). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.selection.elements.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Chart Elements: picks the part of the selected chart the Format commands change (Chart Area, Plot Area or a series); the other tools on the tab then act on it. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.selection.resetToMatchStyle.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Reset to Match Style: takes off the formatting of the chart (area, plot area, series colours, effects, text). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.insertShapes.changeShape.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Change Shape works on a shape drawn inside a chart; a shape drawn from this tab is a shape of the sheet (Shape Format > Edit Shape > Change Shape), so there is none to change here; hidden.

chartFormat.shapeStyles.gallery.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Shape Styles: the 42 styles in the theme colours; the chart area takes the fill, outline and effect of the style. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.shapeStyles.outline.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Shape Outline of the part Chart Elements picked (the chart area or the plot area): a colour, none, and a weight; a series has no drawn outline. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors

chartFormat.shapeStyles.effects.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Shape Effects: shadow (nine offsets), reflection, glow, soft edges and bevel, drawn by the sheet and saved as DrawingML effects; Preset and 3-D Rotation have no engine and are not offered. Quill's effect model (translated from wordcraft). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.wordArt.gallery.note: U:grid/charts-objects: WordArt Styles: the eight styles of Quill (translated from wordcraft wordart.rs) in the theme colours, set on the text of the shape (or of every text of the chart). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.wordArt.textFill.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Text Fill of the shape's text (the chart's text): automatic, none, a colour or a gradient. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors

chartFormat.wordArt.textOutline.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Text Outline of the shape's text (the chart's text): automatic, none, a colour and a weight (a weight keeps the colour). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors

chartFormat.wordArt.textEffects.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Text Effects of the shape's text (the chart's text): Shadow, Glow and Reflection. Transform (text warps), Bevel and 3-D Rotation have no engine here and are not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.accessibility.altText.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Alt Text on the selected object (its description, saved in .xlsx); Excel shows a pane, here it is a dialog with the same description box and Mark as decorative. Not in gridcraft for charts and shapes; not checked against upstream.

chartFormat.arrange.selectionPane.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Selection Pane: the pane that lists the sheet's objects (Page Layout > Selection Pane's command).

chartFormat.arrange.align.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Align the objects picked together: Page Layout > Align's command (arrange.align). Distribute needs three objects picked together.

chartFormat.arrange.group.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Group the objects picked together: Page Layout > Group's command (arrange.group). Regroup and Ungroup put the last group back and split it.

chartFormat.arrange.rotate.note: U:grid/insert-layout: a chart cannot be rotated or flipped (Excel's chart has no Rotate); hidden.

shapeFormat.insertShapes.editShape.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Edit Shape > Change Shape: turns the selected shape into one of the shapes the sheet draws; Edit Points and Reroute Connectors need a path editor the sheet does not have and are not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

shapeFormat.styles.gallery.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Shape Styles: the 42 styles in the theme colours (Colored Outline, Colored Fill, Light 1 Outline Colored Fill, Subtle, Moderate and Intense Effect), each setting the shape's fill, outline and effect. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

shapeFormat.styles.effects.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Shape Effects: shadow (nine offsets), reflection, glow, soft edges and bevel, drawn by the sheet and saved as DrawingML effects; Preset and 3-D Rotation have no engine and are not offered. Quill's effect model (translated from wordcraft). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

shapeFormat.wordArt.gallery.note: U:grid/charts-objects: WordArt Styles: the eight styles of Quill (translated from wordcraft wordart.rs) in the theme colours, set on the text of the shape (or of every text of the chart). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

shapeFormat.wordArt.textFill.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Text Fill of the shape's text (the chart's text): automatic, none, a colour or a gradient. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors

shapeFormat.wordArt.textOutline.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Text Outline of the shape's text (the chart's text): automatic, none, a colour and a weight (a weight keeps the colour). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors

shapeFormat.wordArt.textEffects.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Text Effects of the shape's text (the chart's text): Shadow, Glow and Reflection. Transform (text warps), Bevel and 3-D Rotation have no engine here and are not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

shapeFormat.accessibility.altText.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Alt Text on the selected object (its description, saved in .xlsx); Excel shows a pane, here it is a dialog with the same description box and Mark as decorative. Not in gridcraft for charts and shapes; not checked against upstream.

shapeFormat.arrange.selectionPane.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Selection Pane: the pane that lists the sheet's objects (Page Layout > Selection Pane's command).

shapeFormat.arrange.align.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Align the objects picked together: Page Layout > Align's command (arrange.align). Distribute needs three objects picked together.

shapeFormat.arrange.group.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Group the objects picked together: Page Layout > Group's command (arrange.group). Regroup and Ungroup put the last group back and split it.

pictureFormat.adjust.removeBackground.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Remove Background: the area connected to the picture's edge that is close to its corner colour becomes transparent (Quill's function, translated from wordcraft); there is no marking tool. Reset Picture brings it back. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.adjust.corrections.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Corrections: Brightness/Contrast, 5 x 5 tiles drawn on a sample picture (stored with the picture and drawn with a filter); Sharpen/Soften is not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.adjust.color.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Color: Saturation, Tone (Temperature) and Recolor (grayscale, sepia, washout, black and white), drawn on a sample picture. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.adjust.artisticEffects.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Artistic Effects: blur, sharpen, invert, posterize and pixelate (Quill's functions, translated from wordcraft), one at a time; None takes it off. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.adjust.transparency.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Transparency: 0 to 95 percent presets. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.adjust.compress.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Compress Pictures: the picture resampled so its longer side is at most 1600 pixels (Quill's function, box filter); Excel's options dialog (resolution, delete cropped areas) is not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.adjust.change.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Change Picture > From a File: the system Open dialog; the new picture takes the old one's place with its size and formatting. Stock Images, Online Pictures and Icons need online services and are not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.adjust.reset.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Reset Picture takes off the pixel edits, corrections, colour, crop, border, style and effects; Reset Picture & Size also puts the size back to the picture's own. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.styles.gallery.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Picture Styles: twenty styles the sheet can draw (a border, a frame shape and a shadow, reflection, glow, soft edge or bevel). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.styles.border.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Picture Border: a colour, none, and a weight (a weight keeps the colour). Dashes are not offered. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.styles.effects.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Shape Effects: shadow (nine offsets), reflection, glow, soft edges and bevel, drawn by the sheet and saved as DrawingML effects; Preset and 3-D Rotation have no engine and are not offered. Quill's effect model (translated from wordcraft). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.styles.layout.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Picture Layout turns pictures into SmartArt; the sheet has no SmartArt; hidden.

pictureFormat.accessibility.altText.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Alt Text on the selected object (its description, saved in .xlsx); Excel shows a pane, here it is a dialog with the same description box and Mark as decorative. Not in gridcraft for charts and shapes; not checked against upstream.

pictureFormat.arrange.selectionPane.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Selection Pane: the pane that lists the sheet's objects (Page Layout > Selection Pane's command).

pictureFormat.arrange.align.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Align the objects picked together: Page Layout > Align's command (arrange.align). Distribute needs three objects picked together.

pictureFormat.arrange.group.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Group the objects picked together: Page Layout > Group's command (arrange.group). Regroup and Ungroup put the last group back and split it.

pictureFormat.arrange.rotate.note: U:grid/insert-layout: Rotate Right and Left 90 and Flip turn and mirror the picked pictures and shapes (arrange.rotate degrees, flip), as Page Layout > Rotate.

pictureFormat.size.crop.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Crop: handles on the picture cut its sides; Crop to Shape, Aspect Ratio, Fill and Fit. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.show.highPoint.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Marks the high point of the sparkline in the active cell and its group, in their own colour (Marker Color). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.show.lowPoint.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Marks the low point of the sparkline in the active cell and its group, in their own colour (Marker Color). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.show.negativePoints.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Marks the negative points of the sparkline in the active cell and its group, in their own colour (Marker Color). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.show.firstPoint.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Marks the first point of the sparkline in the active cell and its group, in their own colour (Marker Color). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.show.lastPoint.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Marks the last point of the sparkline in the active cell and its group, in their own colour (Marker Color). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.style.gallery.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Sparkline Styles: 36 styles (Accent 1 to 6 as they are, darker and lighter, Colorful and Dark) setting the series colour and the colours of the marked points. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.style.markerColor.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Marker Color: the colour of the negative points, the markers and the high, low, first and last point. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.group.group.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Group: the sparklines of the selected cells share the first one's type, colours, points and axis and change together (saved as one x14 sparkline group). Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.

sparkline.group.ungroup.note: U:grid/charts-objects: Ungroup: the selected cells' sparkline group becomes single sparklines, each keeping its look. Not in gridcraft; not checked against upstream.
